name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: Senior Product Specialist with 8+ years of experience in Digital Product Management, User Discovery, UX Design, and Go-to-Market (GTM) within educational tech and SaaS platforms. Expert in user research (interviews, usability testing, A/B testing), customer journey mapping, and high-fidelity wireframing/prototyping. Proven track record in competitor benchmarking, product portfolio structuring, and conducting Proof of Concepts (POCs). Dual background in Engineering (UTFPR/UFPR 2.5 yrs) and Philosophy (UFPR), acting as a cross-functional bridge across Pedagogy, Product Tech, and Marketing.

bullets: User Discovery & Product Adoption (Meta): Led usability research and A/B testing for Meta CRM AI features. Mapped user journey friction points and structured enablement materials, boosting usage by +150% and reducing ramp-up by 50%.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Acted as the primary interface across Product, Engineering, Quality, and Sales, translating user feedback into product improvement requirements.
Product Metrics & Performance: Monitored usage KPIs and engagement via Power BI analytics to inform strategic product decisions.
POCs & 0-to-1 MVP Validation: Led the proof of concept and discovery for 'Meu Barzin Pass'. Mapped user journeys, conducted qualitative interviews, and validated product hypotheses.
Usability Testing & Bottleneck Analysis: Analyzed deep-funnel data and mapped API latency bottlenecks (43.9% drop-off), driving UX iterations to improve engagement.
UX Design & Prototyping (40+ Projects): Designed user experience (journeys, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes) for 40+ digital products, conducting continuous usability testing.
CRO & Competitor Benchmarking: Conducted competitor benchmarking and interface A/B testing, increasing user conversion from 8 to 20-30/month (+250%).

0-to-1 Educational SaaS Platform (LMS): Managed product strategy and launch for the first digital LMS platform for Thinking Environment methodology, conducting student research and securing 50 sales in 2 months.
Portfolio Structuring & Content Journeys: Structured educational course catalogs and automated 10-stage learning journeys for retention.
